name: sqlalchemy
description: SQLAlchemy 2.1 Session.begin() and Session.begin_nested() through psycopg 3. Category C faults are injected in this process, once, before the framework sees the error. A top-level ROLLBACK is withheld on psycopg.Connection.rollback; ROLLBACK TO SAVEPOINT is withheld or rewritten in before_cursor_execute. TX-03's next unit of work is a second Session on the same engine (pool_size 1, max_overflow 0).

modes.description: SQLAlchemy's Session.begin() context manager, with Session.begin_nested() for a savepoint. pool_size 1, max_overflow 0. TX-03's next unit of work is a second Session on that same engine. The engine is not disposed between the units, and pool_pre_ping is off.
